limitations: This harness does not render native Three/WebGPU.
Jacobian checks sample the used crown vertices and every seventh changed root vertex, not a formal global proof.
Manual photo polygons establish hair-only intent; their visual placement must be judged in the source and native renders.
Atlas headroom compensation retains linear RGB ratios but entails RGB8 rounding on neutral sheet texels.
The source color contains photographic illumination; the changed-light native comparison is necessary.
